bridge.title: The Bear's Bridge
bridge.prompt: 🐻 The bear needs to cross the river. Build a bridge!

wood.text: Wood is strong and light. The bridge holds the bear and it crosses safely!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy for a simple bridge and it collapses before the bear crosses.

rope.text: Rope alone sags under the bear's weight — it falls into the water!

paper.text: The paper tears as soon as the bear puts a paw on it.

tower.title: The Tallest Tower
tower.prompt: 🚩 Build a tower tall enough to touch the flag!

wood.text: Wooden blocks stack up firmly — the tower reaches the flag!

stone.text: Stone is heavy but stable at the base — the tower stands firm and reaches the flag!

rope.text: Rope can't stand up on its own — the tower never rises.

paper.text: Paper bends under the weight and the tower collapses.

boat.title: The Floating Boat
boat.prompt: ⛵ Build a boat that floats and carries the toys to the other shore!

wood.text: Wood floats really well — the boat sails smoothly!

stone.text: Stone is too dense and sinks as soon as it touches the water.

rope.text: Rope doesn't form a hull — water gets in and the boat sinks.

paper.text: Paper soaks up water, goes soft, and dissolves.

dam.title: The Beaver's Dam
dam.prompt: 🦫 The beaver wants to hold back the river. Build a dam!

wood.text: Wood lets water seep through small gaps — the dam gives way.

stone.text: Stacked stone is heavy and forms a solid wall — the dam holds the river back!

rope.text: Rope can't stop water, which slips right through the strands.

paper.text: The paper dissolves as soon as it touches the water.

catapult.title: The Catapult
catapult.prompt: 🎯 Build a catapult to launch the ball over the wall!

wood.text: The wooden arm is strong and bendy — it flexes and flings the ball far away!

stone.text: Stone is too stiff to bend like an arm — it can't launch anything.

rope.text: Rope is flexible but doesn't push the ball — it just falls to the side.

paper.text: Paper bends and tears, with no force to launch the ball.

crane.title: The Lifting Crane
crane.prompt: 🏗️ Build a crane to lift the heavy box!

wood.text: The wooden arm is light and strong — it lifts the box with ease!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy for its own arm to rise — the crane can't move.

rope.text: Rope bends without a rigid arm — it can't lift the box.

paper.text: The paper tears the moment the box is attached.
